title: llms-full.txt must be no more than params.maxAgeHours old
untested_rationale: checkPresence() (validate-llms-txt.mjs:214) computes ageHours from a live HTTP response's embedded marker or Last-Modified header and compares it to params.maxAgeHours -- there is no pure-function input, only a live time delta, so this id has rule_class: operational and no cases by schema. Unlike security-txt-expiring-soon, params.maxAgeHours IS read on the production call path (validate-llms-txt.mjs:214-215, replacing the literal 4), so the threshold has one home -- but because operational rules cannot carry cases, there is no probe-C analogue for it: a regression changing maxAgeHours from 4 to 400 would go unnoticed by this pilot's gates (recorded as N3 in decisions/0011, the 'derived but unverifiable' rung of the two-axis Specification scorecard). Covered only by human review of this rule file's diff.

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: llms-full.txt has no formal spec of its own. This threshold is a local operational buffer: the composer runs on a 30-minute EventBridge rate plus an event trigger, a 3-hour warn window covers a couple of missed ticks, and +1h accounts for the prod-domain proxy's 1-hour edge cache.
spec.note: conformance_testable is false; no external spec imposes this threshold.
spec.verification_note: clause n/a -- rule_class: operational. normative_quote is a self-authored statement about the ABSENCE of external spec coverage for this transport/fetch/presence condition; there is no external normative clause to transcribe or verify against a source.
